weyl-curvature-hypothesis-initial-state-.title: Weyl Curvature Hypothesis

weyl-curvature-hypothesis-initial-state-.symmetry_origin: The requirement that the initial state of the universe possessed only Ricci curvature (driven by matter and radiation) while possessing minimal gravitational entropy.
weyl-curvature-hypothesis-initial-state-.limits_and_boundary: As the universe expands and structures form via gravitational collapse, the Weyl curvature increases, driving the total entropy of the universe toward its maximum.
